title: Selecting Ollama does not by itself guarantee a book stays on-device
symptom: Tolmach's docs distinguish local Ollama models from Ollama Cloud model selections that send text to hosted infrastructure.
user_impact: Users may incorrectly assume the frontend itself guarantees local-only processing.

steps: Use a locally installed Ollama model and check the exact configured provider before importing private text.

remaining_question: Does the UI make remote data transmission unmistakable for each provider and installed model name?
verification_plan: Inspect model routing in a clean install; record network calls separately for local and explicit-cloud configurations.
